notes.title: Update
notes.content:
New big Update!

14 New Archievments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36215706/62378b729c70f732587245fe8b789c2eb26642d2.png

New Timer 
After rolling the dice, a timer will now appear, counting down and showing you when the current action is 
finished. The timer can be cancelled if you wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36215706/a6523a3cc2aa80bbc6b2a20fc54b7f9691d1dacd.jpg

new Statistics
The new statistics show you which actions were performed, how often and how long. Either just for today or for the whole period.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36215706/c770759c763e9e9ad20f92a3adf288062da82a92.jpg
